title: Let there be light
creator_credit: Victoria. Audio-Visual Education Centre and Ross Campbell
brief_description: the theme of light - natural and man-made - is explored in this film aimed at all levels of the primary school. Depicts, without commentary, all kinds and applications of light from a match to a flame.
